title: tc-synthesis-notes
description:
The person's own conclusions, assumptions and things to verify – editable, reorderable from the keyboard,
removable with Undo, and exported with provenance.

notes.description: The notes, each in the list its `kind` names

sections.description: The lists, in order – by default Conclusions, Assumptions and Still to verify

heading.description: The heading, and the group's name

ownLabel.description: The tag that sets the notes apart from the model's output

sessionId.description: The session the notes belong to – shown on the tray and exported with them

author.description: Who wrote the notes – shown on the tray and exported with them

undoFor.description: How long Undo stays after a removal, in ms; it waits while the pointer or focus is on it. `Infinity` keeps it until the next removal

SynthesisNote.description: One note: its list (a section id) and its text

addLabel.description: The add button and the new field's name, e.g. "Add an assumption"

empty.description: What an empty list says, e.g. "No assumptions yet"

SynthesisSection.description: One of the lists – conclusions, assumptions, things to verify, or your own
